note: The Graph error object and the generic error table. The Conversions API handling-errors page was a 404 in the evidence, so how each code maps to an HTTP status on the events endpoint is ASSUMED and the relay's mapping is tagged so in SOURCE.md.

codes.102: API Session: the login status or access token has expired, been revoked, or is otherwise invalid. Get a new access token.
codes.190: Access token has expired. Get a new access token.
codes.1: API Unknown: possibly a temporary issue due to downtime. Wait and retry.
codes.2: API Service: temporary issue due to downtime. Wait and retry.
codes.4: API Too Many Calls: temporary issue due to throttling. Wait and retry.
codes.17: API User Too Many Calls: temporary issue due to throttling. Wait and retry.
codes.341: Application limit reached: temporary issue due to downtime or throttling. Wait and retry.
codes.613: Calls to this api have exceeded the rate limit (named on the marketing API rate limiting page).
codes.80000: Ad account throttle: there have been too many calls from this ad account (also 80003, 80004, 80014).

business_use_case_header.name: X-Business-Use-Case
business_use_case_header.estimated_time_to_regain_access: Time, in minutes, until calls will no longer be throttled.
